grammar.pattern: 敢 + 动词：勇气与意愿
grammar.purpose: Separate willingness from ability and permission
grammar.explanation: 敢说 expresses daring to speak despite hesitation. 不敢 says the courage is lacking; it does not prove the person cannot speak or is prohibited. 敢不敢试？ asks willingness; 能不能试？ may ask ability or permission in context. Do not pressure a refusal: 可以先听 allows a gradual start.

examples.py: wǒ bù gǎn shuō , dàn tīng dé dǒng .
examples.en: I do not dare speak, but can understand.

examples.py: gǎn bù gǎn xiān shì yī jù ?
examples.en: Would you dare try one sentence first?

examples.zh: 现在不想试，也可以先听。
examples.py: xiàn zài bù xiǎng shì , yě kě yǐ xiān tīng .
examples.en: If you do not want to try now, you may listen first.

commonMistakes.right: 不敢说不一定是不会说。
commonMistakes.why: Courage, competence and permission are separate meanings.

grammar.pattern: 谁都 / 哪儿都 / 疑问词呼应 / 不定指
grammar.purpose: Read a question word used without a question
grammar.explanation: 谁都可以先来听 means everyone is permitted to listen; 谁可以来听？ asks who may attend. 你想读什么，就读什么 links the selected object across clauses. 我想问你什么事 is unnatural for the intended vague sense; 我想问你点儿什么 can mean something unspecified, while 我想问你一件事 is clearer. Scope matters: 谁都 can be narrowed by the notice, and 谁都不 says nobody.

examples.py: shéi dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
examples.en: Anyone may come and listen first.

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng dú shén me , jiù dú shén me .
examples.en: Read whatever you want to read.

examples.zh: 今天哪儿都不去，就在这里。
examples.py: jīn tiān nǎr dōu bù qù , jiù zài zhè lǐ .

commonMistakes.right: 谁都不去，就是没有人去。
commonMistakes.why: The negation changes an inclusive claim to nobody.

lines.zh: 各位，今天谁都可以先来听。
lines.py: gè wèi , jīn tiān shéi dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
lines.en: Everyone, anyone may come and listen first today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用比赛资格吗？
lines.py: bù yòng bǐ sài zī gé ma ?
lines.en: No competition eligibility needed?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 旁听不用，比赛报名要另看标准。
lines.py: páng tīng bù yòng , bǐ sài bào míng yào lìng kàn biāo zhǔn .
lines.en: Not for listening; competition registration has separate criteria.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我有点儿害怕，不敢马上说。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér hài pà , bù gǎn mǎ shàng shuō .
lines.en: I am a little afraid and do not dare speak immediately.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可以先听。想读什么，就先选什么。
lines.py: kě yǐ xiān tīng . xiǎng dú shén me , jiù xiān xuǎn shén me .
lines.en: You may listen first. Start by selecting what you want to read.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 各种难度都有，每个人必须全读吗？
lines.py: gè zhǒng nán dù dōu yǒu , měi gè rén bì xū quán dú ma ?
lines.en: There are various difficulties; must each person read them all?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不用，大家各自选一段，时间足够。
lines.py: bù yòng , dà jiā gè zì xuǎn yī duàn , shí jiān zú gòu .
lines.en: No; each chooses one passage and there is enough time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我先选容易的一段，再试一句。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ xiān xuǎn róng yì de yī duàn , zài shì yī jù .
lines.en: Okay; I will choose an easy passage first and then try one sentence.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Read the scope before joining
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Separate inclusive language from an unstated guarantee.

lines.zh: 公开活动今天开放旁听，任何人都可以先来听。
lines.py: gōng kāi huó dòng jīn tiān kāi fàng páng tīng , rèn hé rén dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
lines.en: The public event opens listening attendance today; anyone may listen first.

lines.zh: 比赛资格和标准写在另一张通知上，还没确认完，这次怕不能马上开始。
lines.py: bǐ sài zī gé hé biāo zhǔn xiě zài lìng yī zhāng tōng zhī shàng , hái méi què rèn wán , zhè cì pà bù néng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ .
lines.en: Competition eligibility and criteria are on another notice; checking is unfinished, so we probably cannot start immediately.

lines.zh: 谁都可以听，不是说谁都已经有比赛资格。
lines.py: shéi dōu kě yǐ tīng , bù shì shuō shéi dōu yǐ jīng yǒu bǐ sài zī gé .
lines.en: Everyone may listen; it does not say everyone is already eligible to compete.

lines.zh: 每个人各自选一段，不用把各种难度都选。
lines.py: měi gè rén gè zì xuǎn yī duàn , bù yòng bǎ gè zhǒng nán dù dōu xuǎn .
lines.en: Each person selects one passage independently; no need to select every difficulty.

lines.zh: 害怕说错可以先听，不敢和不会不是同一个意思。
lines.py: hài pà shuō cuò kě yǐ xiān tīng , bù gǎn hé bù huì bù shì tóng yī gè yì si .
lines.en: If afraid of a mistake, listen first; not daring and not knowing how differ.

lines.zh: 你想读什么就读什么，但是先看这次允许的范围。
lines.py: nǐ xiǎng dú shén me jiù dú shén me , dàn shì xiān kàn zhè cì yǔn xǔ de fàn wéi .
lines.en: Read what you want, but first check the scope permitted this time.

lines.zh: 各组都有不同安排，各地朋友也不能替别人选择。
lines.py: gè zǔ dōu yǒu bù tóng ān pái , gè dì péng you yě bù néng tì bié ren xuǎn zé .
lines.en: Each group has different arrangements; friends from different places cannot choose on others’ behalf.

lines.zh: 怕是要再等一会儿，先问清楚，再决定试不试。
lines.py: pà shì yào zài děng yī huì er , xiān wèn qīng chǔ , zài jué dìng shì bù shì .
lines.en: We probably need to wait a little longer; clarify first and then decide whether to try.

pragmatics.note: Confirm before treating an invitation as eligibility.

conversation.title: Anyone can join
